outputs: Generated text sequences (tokens) produced by LLMs for various NLG tasks
Energy consumption, latency, throughput, and GPU power metrics during NLG inference

datasets: Azure LLM Inference chat and code traces

changes_made.explanation: Added missing NLG tasks explicitly mentioned in the paper (text classification, code generation, conversational AI). Removed duplicate dataset entries and normalized model names. Added explicit mention of Llama-3.2-1B used in speculative decoding.
The paper does not evaluate NLG outputs using automatic NLG evaluation metrics. It only measures system performance metrics (energy, latency, throughput, GPU power) during inference.
No LLMs are used as judges to evaluate generated outputs in this paper. LLMs are only used as the generation models being evaluated for energy efficiency.
No human evaluations of generated outputs are conducted in this paper. The evaluation focuses exclusively on system-level performance metrics.

overall_notes: This paper is primarily about energy efficiency analysis of LLM inference across various NLG tasks, not about evaluating the quality of generated text. The extracted metadata correctly reflects that the paper evaluates system performance (energy, latency, throughput) rather than output quality using automatic metrics, LLM judges, or human evaluations.
